versions.name: Git checkout
versions.description: Check out a Git repository into the workspace — the buz equivalent of actions/checkout. Checks out the triggering commit (BUZ_GIT_SHA) by default on webhook triggers; ref accepts branches, tags, and commit SHAs (detached); optional submodules.
versions.description_zh: 将 Git 仓库检出到 workspace——对标 actions/checkout。webhook 触发时默认检出触发提交（BUZ_GIT_SHA）；ref 支持分支、标签和 commit SHA（detached）；可选拉取 submodules。
versions.author: buz maintainers
